en.question: If the opponent activates the effect of <<6980>> in a chain to the activation of <<10666>>, so that the targeted monster in the Graveyard is banished by the time the effect resolves, how does this resolve?
en.title: If the opponent activates the effect of <<6980>> in a chain to the activation of <<10666>>, so that the targeted monster in the Graveyard is banished by the time the effect resolves, how does this resolve?

ja.answer:
「<<10666>>」の効果処理時に対象に選択した墓地のモンスターが、墓地に存在しなくなっている場合、「<<10666>>」の効果処理は適用されません。
（モンスターは1体も特殊召喚されません。）
